summary: Super Group (SGHC) Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a change in segment reporting structure approved by the CODM in Q1 2026, effective for FY2026. The company will now report under two new segments (Africa and International) replacing the previous Betway and Spin segments. No deal terms, prices, or special situation exists. This is a routine reporting change to align with internal management and does not constitute a special situation filing.
